nom: Bubble Day Dream Vitamin C + Niacinamide Tone & Texture Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the serum feels light, layers well under a gel moisturizer, and one notes her skin looks less oily with continued use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum is hydrating and soothing, though a couple mention it can feel drying on its own and pair it with a separate moisturizer.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, sensitive skin reports she can now wear makeup all day without breaking out.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin (including rosacea, melasma, and acne-prone sensitive skin) most often report the serum is gentle with little to no irritation, though one reviewer with rosacea/dermatitis reports it burned and increased redness.
segments.mature: One older reviewer reports no sensitivity and good results after trying several vitamin C serums; another notes reduced fine lines on the forehead.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report brighter, more even skin and some note softened fine lines or wrinkles; results are described as visible but gradual over weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and soft-making, but a few say it can leave skin dry and need a separate moisturizer, and one found it too light to see a difference.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness or ruddiness, including one pairing it with azelaic acid; one reviewer with rosacea/dermatitis reports the opposite, with burning and increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report improved barrier feel and no new sensitivity with continued use; one credits it with improving her skin barrier directly.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of hyperpigmentation, dark spots, melasma, and acne scars, though one experienced user reports the vitamin C did virtually nothing for her hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer bumps, clearer skin, or no new breakouts, including some acne-prone users; however, one reviewer reports the product made her break out and caused foundation to pill, and another still gets occasional pimples.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily/acne-prone skin report the serum is light and non-greasy and note skin looks less oily, while one reviewer reports it made her skin feel greasy.

aspects.libelle: Opaque bottle hard to gauge remaining product
Bottle hard to open when near empty
Runs out quickly for the price

extraits.titre: Wanted to like it so bad
extraits.texte: Like the title says, I wanted to like this oroduct so bad because I've been searching for a product to help lighten my hyperpigmentation/acne scars. Instantly burned and turned my even redder skin MORE red, so now I'm on the toilet with a cold compress all over my face. Rosacea, dermatitis, and sensitive skin/acne prone ladies—I'm sorry, but you should pass on this one. Should've read the reviews before purchasing lol

The serum is GREAT if you're a beginner, but only somewhat decent if you're experienced. If you have sensitive skin or haven't tried the active ingredients in this serum, then it's a great serum to start with since it's gentle and has tons of ceramides to protect your skins natural barrier. That being said, for experienced active users, the vitamin c does virtually nothing in this product and I saw limited results after a solid month of daily use. The tranexamic acid, alpha arbutin, and niacinamide are the heavy hitters in this product. Although they only slightly reduce post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (or post acne dark marks), it does help to minimize how severe or dark new marks are from ongoing breakouts. And the ceramides are a great touch for both barrier replenishment and moisturizing. For the price though, I was really hoping this product would be as strong if not stronger than when I applied the Inkey lists tranexamic acid and alpha arbutin together without all the other ingredients in bubbles product. Those two actives from Inkey when combined worked wonders for my hyperpigmentation and in way less time, but bubbles product really fell short. However, I am going to give it one more months effort just to be sure. I don't hate the product, I just want a much stronger version of it. Please make a stronger version!

I love this stuff! I've almost finished my bottle. The fact it has not only Vitamin C and Niacinamide, but also tranexamic acid is fantastic for someone like myself who has melasma and sensitive skin. Even from the start the most my skin reacted was by getting a little red and warm, but after several uses that has virtually gone away. My melasma has faded noticeably, my skin is clear of blemishes 90% of the time (I still get the occasional pimple), and it's so smooth! Highly recommend.

I'm a 33 year old woman with sensitive, blackhead-prone skin and a mild case of melasma. This stuff is gentle enough for my skin but also effective, the overall texture and appearance of my skin has continued to improve with use. I've gone through two bottles and am about to order a third, I really hope they never change the formula or discontinue it because this is my holy grail serum!

I have an acne prone and oily skin. My skin only tolerates water base gel type of moisturizer. This vitamin c is light, moisturizing. I apply it before my gel moisturizer. My skin is hydrated, with a small glow. I like the product.

I bought this last month to help with my acne/acne scars along with hyperpigmentation from sun damage, and just after a week of using it all my acne and dark spots have faded! My skin texture also felt much more smoother and soft! I have very sensitive acne prone skin and using this has improved my skin barrier; the more consistent u are with using this the better long term results youll have!

I have combo, sensitive skin and used to break out whenever I wore makeup; however, since I started using this, I can wear full face all day and won't break out. Will repurchase. Absolutely recommend.
